speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You presented with right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision. To begin my assessment, can you tell me exactly how your leg is positioned when you are in pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Since you report severe right groin pain after a rear-end collision, did the accident cause you to involuntarily slam your right leg against the dashboard or seat?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe right groin pain. I also have Pain in both knees, Right leg is slightly shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Right femoral neck fracture.
